criteria_results.text: The mobile client's SSE consumer streams on native platforms: gateway-shaped frames (including projectless desktop events whose directory is the pseudonymous project id) cross the client parse boundary, split chunks reassemble, non-streaming responses fail loudly instead of hanging.
criteria_results.notes: Jest regression (5 tests) plus live Metro boundary diagnostics on the physical iPhone: message.updated / message.part.updated / deltas received with pseudonymized directory matching activeProjectPath, refresh scheduled, transcript committed.

criteria_results.text: While a desktop-originated projectless chat is open on the physical iPhone, desktop user and assistant turns appear automatically without refresh, and mobile turns appear live on desktop.
criteria_results.notes: User confirmed both directions live without refresh, first on the instrumented bundle ('both worked!') and again on a cold start of the cleaned bundle ('messaging worked both ways'). Root cause of the prior C2 on issue-1285-c21: React Native's XHR-backed fetch cannot stream SSE, so zero envelopes (not even server.connected or heartbeats) ever reached the client loop, while the optimistic eventStreamStatus='connected' disabled the 5s polling fallback. The prior server-only live test passed because it exercised the gateway with a real streaming fetch, not the device runtime.

process_issues.description: Temporary diagnostics were added and removed via multi-step edits while the physical device was attached to Metro with Fast Refresh; intermediate states (missing import, then dangling diag() calls) hot-reloaded to the device, producing a red-box crash whose degraded state (lost paired scope, catalog-path 502 loop, one transcript-load failure) was briefly mistaken by the user for a significant regression.
process_issues.detected_by: Metro console: 'ReferenceError: Property diag doesn't exist' render error immediately after cleanup edits; 502 loop ceased after full reload; cold-start retest passed.

process_issues.description: Two pre-existing defects surfaced during smoke and were recorded on tracker #1287 instead of expanding scope: (1) cold-start first transcript open can exceed the 15s OPEN_PROJECT_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS budget over Tailscale (retry loads); (2) catalog-scoped client calls hit bare gateway paths and 502 whenever paired scope is lost or polling runs degraded.
process_issues.detected_by: User report during final smoke plus Metro console; residuals commented on issue #1287.

Precedence given to the explicit user instructions per CLAUDE.md.
issues.detected_by: Transcript inspection: no Skill invocations for orchestrator/acceptance-contract/verification-gate; equivalent evidence captured inline.

suggested_follow_up: Acceptance contracts for mobile realtime behavior must include a device-runtime-inclusive assertion (or an explicit statement that the runtime transport differs from the test transport); a server-only raw-fetch SSE test structurally cannot catch React Native fetch's inability to stream, which is exactly how issue-1285-c21 passed while the device failed.
